target.title: fix(googlechat): bound auth transporter fetches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Google Chat accounts that need google-auth token or certificate requests could wait indefinitely when the Google auth HTTP path stalls before returning a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Google Chat plugin already bounds direct Chat API calls and webhook certificate fetches. This change applies the same 30s guarded-fetch deadline to the google-auth transporter path while preserving its existing SSRF allowlist, proxy, mTLS, response buffering, and resource release behavior.

## User Impact

Google Chat outbound sends and token verification no longer get stuck forever on a hung google-auth network request; they fail on the existing timeout boundary so the runtime can surface an actionable failure and continue processing later work.

## Evidence
